name: Sissy Squat
research: On the balls of the feet both pictures: ball fixed at (0.12,-0.15,0); foot rot X +40 lifts the ankle to B+(0,0.060,0.147) = (0.12,-0.09,0.147). Start: straight legs, pelvis = ankle + (0,0.066,0.897) - 0.01 = (0,-0.024,1.035). End: shin tilts 60 deg forward -> knee (0.12,-0.48,0.37); thigh leans back 40 deg -> hip L (0.11,-0.19,0.72); knee flexion 60+40 = 100 deg; trunk in line with thigh: root rot X -40; pelvis joint = hip centre + Rx(-40)(0,0.051,-0.003) = (0,-0.154,0.682). Hip L to ankle 0.58 m checks out with 100 deg. Shin 60 deg vs trunk 40 deg = tibia 20 deg more inclined = knee-extensor bias (Straub & Powers 2024). Quad EMG peaks near 90 deg (Marchetti 2016 PMC4967668). Library says hold a post; there is no post prop, so both arms reach forward for balance (elev 50 in torso frame = level in world when leaning back 40). Neck/head tip forward 12/10 so he looks ahead.
